name: Side Plank
description: Support the body sideways on one forearm and the feet to train lateral trunk stability.

items.content: Set the supporting elbow beneath the shoulder and press firmly into the floor.
Stack shoulders and hips; lift the hips into line with the head and feet.
Keep the neck long and avoid rolling the chest toward the floor.
Stagger the feet or rest the lower knee down for support; breathe and repeat on both sides.

stages.name: Hold
stages.description: Body sideways above the floor, supported on one forearm and stacked feet. Elbow beneath shoulder, hips lifted, free hand on the upper hip, and head aligned with the torso.
